# The White Witch™

> LibreSky, a free Bluesky client with edit, AI, voice, video, and chat. Emoji games. The MAGIC language. RETRO MAGIC for the C64, the Apple II, and the TI-99/4A.

No accounts on this site. The work is linked below.

## LibreSky

- [LibreSky](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/LibreSky/): Bluesky client in the browser. Edit, AI, voice, video, and chat.
- [LibreSky Corporate](https://thewhitewitchtm.github.io/corporate/): self-hosted services, small enough for a Pi. Coming soon.
- [LibreSky source](https://github.com/TheWhiteWitchTM/LibreSky)
